body:
The human edits and approves a release's drafted notes the same way they would a proposal. Approved notes are stored with the release and show with it on the Build tab.

- Rejected notes are not stored.
- Approved notes stay with the release after a restart.

Done when: a drafted set of notes can be edited and approved, and the approved notes are kept with that release and shown with it.
title: notes: edit, approve and store
